def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Select the uniform separator.
    col = next((c for c in range(w)
                if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))), None)
    if col is not None:
        sides = [[row[:col] for row in grid], [row[col + 1:] for row in grid]]
        # Marker panel is the side whose common background is zero, when present;
        # otherwise use the side with the more frequent zero background.
        def score(panel):
            vals = [v for row in panel for v in row]
            from collections import Counter
            counts = Counter(vals)
            bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
            return (bg == 0, counts[bg] / len(vals))
        panel = max(sides, key=score)
    else:
        row = next(r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1)
        panels = [grid[:row], grid[row + 1:]]
        panel = panels[0] if len(panels[0]) <= len(panels[1]) else panels[1]

    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for line in panel for v in line)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[2 if v != background else 0 for v in line] for line in panel]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # The uniform line is a divider. Select the sparse-pattern panel.
    sep_col = next((c for c in range(w)
                    if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))), None)
    if sep_col is not None:
        panels = [
            [row[:sep_col] for row in grid],
            [row[sep_col + 1:] for row in grid],
        ]
    else:
        sep_row = next(r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1)
        panels = [grid[:sep_row], grid[sep_row + 1:]]

    # In the panel with the sparse pattern, the most common value is
    # background; all other values are pattern cells.
    from collections import Counter
    panel = min(panels, key=lambda p: max(Counter(v for row in p for v in row).values()))
    counts = Counter(v for row in panel for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[2 if v != background else 0 for v in row] for row in panel]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(c for c in range(w)
               if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)))
    panels = [[row[:sep] for row in grid],
              [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]]

    from collections import Counter
    # Choose the panel with the more dominant background and preserve its
    # minority-color pattern.
    def panel_info(p):
        counts = Counter(v for row in p for v in row)
        background, n = counts.most_common(1)[0]
        return n / sum(counts.values()), p, background

    _, panel, background = max(map(panel_info, panels), key=lambda x: x[0])
    return [[2 if v != background else 0 for v in row] for row in panel]
